items.title: Making several isolated fibre points finite over one elementary etale neighbourhood
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Given a locally finite type morphism and finitely many isolated points of a fibre mapping to one base point, the lemma produces one elementary etale neighbourhood of the base point and, for each given point, an open subscheme of the base change that is finite over the neighbourhood and has a unique point over the base point mapping to the given point with equal residue field. The proof handles each point using its isolation in the fibre, then assembles the pieces over a common etale neighbourhood so that all conditions hold simultaneously. Making one neighbourhood serve all points is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 11997-12012.
